text:
rosa: Heads-up — GateKeeper Inc wants to start a 6-week POC next week. Requirements: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning for ~12k users (delta + full), group->role RBAC mapping, domain proofing across 3 domains. They also asked about pricing for a short Dedicated window vs hosted with burst. Can @vikram / @jamie help validate blockers?

vikram: Thanks. Quick Qs: do they control all 3 domains or are some shared? Domain proofing affects tenant routing and our certs. Also need their expected monthly MAU to size dedicated pool.

rosa: They own all 3 but one is an external subdomain (+org.co). MAU estimate ~350k monthly, peak spikes up to 1.2k rps auth events during marketing blasts.

jamie: Security side — confirm they require signed assertions + encrypted responses? Also will they demand specific NameID format (email vs persistent)? PII rules?

rosa: They requested signed assertions and want email NameID for account linking. No additional PII beyond email and name.

leo: Pricing note: for a 6-month Dedicated commit we can propose a short-term reserved SKU. If they want flexibility, recommend hosted with "burst" policy and a negotiated spike cap; hosted unit costs are higher but no infra lock. I can sketch numbers after we confirm capacity needs.

vikram: SCIM: 12k active users is fine but bulk creates cause throttling if they do one big sync. Recommend supporting incremental delta sync and a backoff guide. Example delta fetch header we expect: 
```
GET /scim/v2/Users?startIndex=1&count=100&filter=lastModified gt 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```
We also need to confirm whether their IdP will push group membership as SCIM groups or via SAML claims.

jamie: For RBAC mapping we prefer explicit SCIM group->role mapping in the POC config rather than relying on SAML claims. Sample mapping snippet: 
```
"group_mappings": [{"scim_group":"eng-admins","platform_role":"admin"},{"scim_group":"support","platform_role":"viewer"}]
```
This keeps provisioning auditable.

vikram: Domain proofing: we support TXT record method for each domain. One caveat: for subdomain delegation they need to ensure DNS TTLs are low during prove. Also if they want custom certs we need CN/SAN details.

rosa: They asked about IP allowlisting + VPC peering for the Dedicated instance for strict egress. Do we have a standard checklist?

vikram: Yes: for Redwood Private / Dedicated we can do VPC peering + IP allowlist. Need to confirm KMS integration (customer-managed keys) and log export destination (S3/GCS) for audit. Also note: KMS + HSM requirements push towards Private on-prem or VPC with KMS; hosted can't use customer HSM.

leo: On canary/fallback: we can recommend a rollout policy that falls back to a smaller hosted model variant for non-critical routes if Dedicated capacity hits limits. That helps reliability during blasts but needs budgeting.

jamie: Security questionnaire action items: 1) confirm assertion signing algorithm (RSA-SHA256), 2) SCIM OAuth2 client creds rotation policy, 3) audit log retention. I can draft answers if someone gives me the SAML metadata and SCIM base URL.

rosa: SAML metadata from GateKeeper SRE incoming tomorrow morning. I'll put them on a call Fri 10am PT.

ops-bot: Created ticket #RDW-4821 to track POC entitlement & infra asks (owner: vikram). Added checklist: SAML metadata, SCIM endpoint, group mapping file, domain TXT proofs, MAU/peak RPS, KMS requirement.

vikram: Next steps from infra side: I need their SCIM test credentials + a small CSV of group mappings to run a dry-run. Also want to validate lockstep between SCIM deltas and our KV cache TTLs to avoid stale role assignments.

rosa: Great — I'll request test creds and CSV on the call. Leo — can you prepare two pricing scenarios (6-month Dedicated vs hosted + burst) so we can present on Friday?

leo: On it. I'll post numbers and a 1-page comparison before EOD Thu.

jamie: I'll prepare the security answers and a minimal SAML compliance checklist for the call.

rosa: Perfect. Let’s sync Fri 10am PT with GateKeeper SRE + infra. Thanks all :rocket:
